description: Source file implementing the OgHttp2Adapter class for HTTP/2 protocol handling, including methods for session management, frame submission, and window size queries.

classes.name: OgHttp2Adapter
classes.description: HTTP/2 adapter class managing session interactions, frame submissions, and stream data.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new OgHttp2Adapter instance.

methods.name: ~OgHttp2Adapter
methods.description: Destructor for OgHttp2Adapter.

methods.name: IsServerSession
methods.description: Checks if the session is a server session.

methods.name: ProcessBytes
methods.description: Processes incoming bytes for the session.

methods.name: SubmitSettings
methods.description: Submits HTTP/2 settings.

methods.name: SubmitPriorityForStream
methods.description: Submits a priority frame for a stream.

methods.name: SubmitPing
methods.description: Submits a ping frame.

methods.name: SubmitShutdownNotice
methods.description: Initiates a graceful shutdown.

methods.name: SubmitGoAway
methods.description: Sends a GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: SubmitWindowUpdate
methods.description: Submits a window update frame.

methods.name: SubmitMetadata
methods.description: Submits metadata for a stream.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends queued frames.

methods.name: GetSendWindowSize
methods.description: Retrieves the remote window size.

methods.name: GetStreamSendWindowSize
methods.description: Retrieves the send window size for a specific stream.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the receive window limit for a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Retrieves the receive window size for a stream.

methods.name: GetReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Retrieves the overall receive window size.

methods.name: GetHpackEncoderDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Gets the HPACK encoder's dynamic table size.

methods.name: GetHpackEncoderDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Gets the HPACK encoder's dynamic table capacity.

methods.name: GetHpackDecoderDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Gets the HPACK decoder's dynamic table size.

methods.name: GetHpackDecoderSizeLimit
methods.description: Gets the HPACK decoder size limit.

methods.name: GetHighestReceivedStreamId
methods.description: Returns the highest received stream ID.

methods.name: MarkDataConsumedForStream
methods.description: Marks data as consumed for a stream.

methods.name: SubmitRst
methods.description: Submits a RST_STREAM frame.

methods.name: SubmitRequest
methods.description: Submits a request on a stream.

methods.name: SubmitResponse
methods.description: Submits a response on a stream.

methods.name: SubmitTrailer
methods.description: Submits trailer headers.

methods.name: SetStreamUserData
methods.description: Associates user data with a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamUserData
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with a stream.

methods.name: ResumeStream
methods.description: Resumes a paused stream.
